# RESEARCH NOTE
## A note that publishes its own printed layout

---
**Publisher:** Paperforge Research
**Date:** August 2026

---

This document declares `pdf = "chrome"`, so what is published is exactly what a
reader sees on screen, printed. That is the right choice when the reading
edition already carries the layout that matters — a wide table turned onto a
landscape page, for instance — and the wrong one when the document needs real
footnotes at the foot of the page.

The browser prints this document anyway, to measure where its headings land.
Declaring the edition promotes that copy from a cache by-product to a named
deliverable, which is what makes publishing it a decision rather than an
accident of which files happen to exist.
